World.title: São Paulo Nightlife Guide for Sunday, May 10, 2026.
World.content:
The Rio Times · RT Nightlife Desk DIA DAS MÃES + COLD FRONT · CÉSAR MENOTTI & FABIANO at Espaço Unimed 20h · BLUE NOTE SP Mother’s Day show 19h + Brunch Music 10h–17h free · BAR BRAHMA CENTRO Luana Gaudy “Damas do Samba” 13h30 + Forró no Centro · 16 °C · 68 % rain · Augusta dampened · Vila Madalena dampened · Mon May 11 reset 20 °C · 10 % rain

01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

São Paulo nightlife runs on the rarest combination of factors today: Mother’s Day in Brazil (Dia das Mães, second Sunday of May) collides with the cold front the Saturday weather had warned about — Sunday at 16 °C with 68 % rain is the year’s most decisive autumn-pattern day so far, and the city’s programming has pivoted almost entirely indoor. The big-room anchor is César Menotti & Fabiano at Espaço Unimed: the sertanejo dupla brings their Mother’s Day special to R. Tagipuru 795 in Barra Funda at 20h, tickets R$140 meia / R$280 inteira via Ticket360 — “Leilão”, “Como um Anjo”, “Ciumenta”, “Caso por Acaso”, the catalogue that has run for over two decades. Blue Note SP on Av. Paulista runs both halves of its Mother’s Day Sunday: Brunch Music on the 2º andar from 10h to 17h with live music and free entry (R$116 buffet à vontade), then a special Mother’s Day evening show at 19h via Eventim. Bar Brahma Centro on Av. São João runs the strongest indoor samba Mother’s Day programme: Luana Gaudy canta “As Damas do Samba” in the Salão Principal 13h30–16h30, plus Almoço na Varanda com Luiz França, plus Forró no Centro com Robson Baza, plus performances by Fernanda Ouro and Rafael Rodrigues across the day. The weekend’s standing nightlife circuits run dampened: Augusta bars open but with cold-front foot traffic, Vila Madalena bar terraces wet and quiet, D-Edge Sunday closed as standard. Tomorrow Mon May 11 resets cool-and-dry: 20 °C, 10 % rain; Tue May 12 brings the Blue Note SP marquee weeknight show: Projeto Tânia Maria — The Lady From Brazil at 20h. Today: lunch with the family indoors, evening sertanejo or jazz ticket, taxi back through the rain.

02

Top Picks Tonight

Fast scan

César Menotti & Fabiano — Mother’s Day at Espaço Unimed

20h · R$140 meia / R$280 inteira · Ticket360 · Barra Funda The sertanejo Mother’s Day big-room anchor. Two-decade catalogue with “Leilão”, “Como um Anjo”, “Ciumenta”, “Caso por Acaso”. The most-booked Mother’s Day SP family show. R. Tagipuru 795 — Barra Funda. Easiest by 99/Uber from Centro or Av. Paulista.

Blue Note SP — Brunch Music + Mother’s Day evening

10h–17h free brunch + 19h ticketed · Av. Paulista Two-tier Sunday on Av. Paulista 2073, Conjunto Nacional. Free-entry Brunch Music until 17h with live music and R$116 buffet à vontade. Single Mother’s Day evening show at 19h via Eventim. Direct metro at Consolação.

Bar Brahma Centro — Mother’s Day Indoor Samba Day

From 13h30 · Av. São João · Centro The indoor Mother’s Day samba lunch. Luana Gaudy “Damas do Samba” 13h30–16h30 in the Salão Principal, plus Luiz França almoço na Varanda, plus Forró no Centro with Robson Baza, plus Fernanda Ouro and Rafael Rodrigues across the day. Av. São João 677 — Centro.

03

Full Rundown

Espaço Unimed — César Menotti & Fabiano (Mother’s Day) Barra Funda · Sertanejo · Big Room · Ticket360 The Mother’s Day big-room anchor. César Menotti & Fabiano — the Belo Horizonte sertanejo dupla active since the early 2000s — bring their Mother’s Day special to Espaço Unimed on R. Tagipuru 795 in Barra Funda at 20h. The 8,000-capacity room (Brazil’s third-largest indoor concert hall by capacity, after Allianz Parque and Espaço Unimed Nordeste) handles the largest of the city’s Mother’s Day Sunday programmes. The setlist runs through the catalogue that has anchored two decades of sertanejo radio — “Leilão”, “Como um Anjo”, “Ciumenta”, “Caso por Acaso”, plus the more recent material. The framing of tonight is explicitly mother-and-child shared experience: the dupla pitches the show as “an encounter where music functions as the link between different moments in life”, which translates in practice to a room of multi-generational family booking with mothers and adult children seated together. Tickets R$140 meia / R$280 inteira via Ticket360. Address R. Tagipuru 795, Barra Funda. Closest metro Marechal Deodoro (Red Line 3); easiest route from Av. Paulista, Centro or Vila Madalena is 99/Uber, allow 25–35 minutes including Sunday-evening Mother’s-Day surge. Sun May 10 · 20h · R$140 meia / R$280 inteira · R. Tagipuru 795 — Barra Funda · Metro Marechal Deodoro · Ticket360

Blue Note SP — Brunch Music + Mother’s Day evening show Av. Paulista · Day & Night · Free Brunch Entry · Eventim Two-tier Sunday on Av. Paulista. Day: Brunch Music runs every Sunday from 10h to 17h in the Conjunto Nacional 2º andar — free venue entry, live music throughout the day with the resident Sunday-band rotation, R$116 buffet à vontade, à la carte options also available, the Av. Paulista view through the windows. The format is built for the long Sunday lunch and Mother’s Day reservations near the windows are the bairro’s most-booked of the year — Sunday-morning walk-ins likely without a window seat unless arrival is by 10h30. Night: a single Mother’s Day evening show at 19h in the salão de shows, listing flagged “DIA DAS MÃES” on Eventim with the cupom MAESEVENTIM applying for inteira discount. The Eventim listing was still flagging “ainda disponível” 24 hours before the show; same-day booking possible but not guaranteed. The Sunday format runs until 17h on the brunch side; the evening show closes the night by 21h–22h. Address Av. Paulista 2073, 2º andar — Conjunto Nacional. Direct metro access at Consolação. Brunch Music · Sun 10h–17h · free entry · R$116 buffet · Mother’s Day show · 19h · Eventim · Av. Paulista 2073 · Metro Consolação

Bar Brahma Centro — Mother’s Day Indoor Samba & Forró Day Centro · Multiple Stages · Indoor · Samba + Forró The cold-front-friendly indoor Mother’s Day samba day. Bar Brahma Centro — the institution at the corner of Av. Ipiranga and Av. São João that Caetano Veloso put into the popular imagination with “Sampa” — runs its full Mother’s Day programme across multiple rooms. The principal show: “Especial Dia das Mães: Luana Gaudy canta As Damas do Samba” in the Salão Principal from 13h30 to 16h30, the singer’s tribute to the women who built Brazilian samba. Parallel programming: Almoço na Varanda com Luiz França (the Sunday-lunch slot), the Forró no Centro com Robson Baza project (the casa’s regular forró programme; Mother’s Day edition), plus solo sets by Fernanda Ouro and Rafael Rodrigues rotating through the smaller stages. The casa’s three-floor structure handles the day’s multi-track programming with the Salão Principal carrying the headline samba, the Varanda the lunch crowd, and the smaller rooms the rotating sets. Indoor and dry: the standing Mother’s Day plan if Espaço Unimed is full or out of budget. Address Av. São João 677, Centro. Metro República. The bairro is calmer Sunday but the building is well-secured and the corner is the city’s most carioca-style outdoor-pavement location — only the rain spoils that today. Sun May 10 · From 13h30 · Av. São João 677 — Centro · Metro República · check Bar Brahma channels for ticket platform

04

Suggested Route

● Plan A — Sertanejo Mother’s Day big room. Family lunch wherever you booked, then 99/Uber to Espaço Unimed for César Menotti & Fabiano 20h. Two-hour sertanejo set, return via taxi straight from the venue’s egress on R. Tagipuru. The largest, most polished plan. ● Plan B — Av. Paulista Sunday. Blue Note SP Brunch Music from 10h30 (or earlier for window seats), the live samba running through to 17h. Walk Av. Paulista in the rain or rest in the afternoon, return for the 19h Mother’s Day show in the salão. Both halves under one roof, direct metro. ● Plan C — Centro indoor samba. Bar Brahma from 13h30 for Luana Gaudy “Damas do Samba”, lunch on the Varanda, the rotating programmes through the afternoon. The most carioca-style Mother’s Day plan, scaled for SP and entirely indoor. Lower budget than Espaço Unimed, no ticket queue. ● The combined route: Bar Brahma 13h30 lunch + samba, taxi to Av. Paulista 17h for tea or coffee in the bairro, Espaço Unimed 20h for César Menotti & Fabiano. The day-into-night Mother’s Day full programme, weather-proof.

05

Still Going After 10 pm

Sunday after 22h: César Menotti & Fabiano in the closing stretch at Espaço Unimed, the room running until 22h–22h30 close. Blue Note SP Mother’s Day evening show wraps by 21h–21h30; the casa’s piano bar and gastronomia run until late but the structured programmation is done. Bar Brahma programmation tapers from late afternoon; the bar runs into the evening but the headline samba is finished. The standing nightlife circuits run dampened by the cold front: Augusta corridor open but with cold-front foot traffic, kitchens running until 02h–03h, the Beco 203 / Cabaret / Z Carniceria DJ format works indoors but Sunday-night attendance is the week’s lowest. Vila Madalena bars wet, terraces unusable; the indoor format at Filial and the chopperias along Wisard runs at half capacity. D-Edge closed Sunday as standard. Tomorrow Mon May 11: cool-and-dry reset (20 °C, 10 % rain), the city’s normal Monday slow gear with no major show. Tue May 12: Projeto Tânia Maria — The Lady From Brazil at Blue Note SP 20h — the marquee weeknight programme, the project celebrating one of Brazil’s most influential jazz-MPB pianists internationally, plus a 22h30 second session (“ainda disponível” via Eventim). Wed May 13 onward: full Av. Paulista return.

06

Plan B

› D.O.M. — R. Barão de Capanema 549, Jardins. Atala’s flagship for the high-end Mother’s Day lunch. Pre-booked weeks ago for the principal hours; check for late availability or off-peak slots. › Tordesilhas — Al. Tietê 489, Jardins. Brazilian regional cuisine institution, the Mother’s Day Sunday-lunch carioca-MPB-circle reservation. Indoor, weather-proof, Mother’s Day–booked. › Riviera Bar — Av. Paulista 2584, Consolação. The reactivated 1949 boteco-piano-bar. Live music Sunday afternoon-evening; covered terrace handles light rain. › Pinacoteca + MASP — both on the Av. Paulista / Luz axis open Sunday with Mother’s Day pricing on selected exhibitions. The cold-front-proof cultural Sunday afternoon if the family lunch wraps early. › In Rio today: Mother’s Day Sunday in Rio runs hot and dry (26 °C, 20 % rain) with Quarteto Indiara at Theatro Municipal Assyrio 11h R$25, Pedra do Sal Sunday roda from 18h, Blue Note Rio Sunday brunch from 13h. The carioca parallel. › Tomorrow Mon May 11: cool-and-dry reset 20 °C / 10 % rain · the city’s normal Monday slow gear · no major show. Tue May 12: Projeto Tânia Maria — The Lady From Brazil at Blue Note SP 20h + 22h30.

07

Getting Around

Espaço Unimed (Barra Funda): Metro Marechal Deodoro (Red Line 3) closest, then 7-minute walk in the rain — most arrivals via 99/Uber from Centro or Av. Paulista, allow 25–35 minutes with Mother’s Day Sunday-evening surge. Blue Note SP (Av. Paulista): Metro Consolação (Yellow Line 4) directly underneath the Conjunto Nacional. Bar Brahma (Centro): Metro República (Red Line 3 / Yellow Line 4) — three-minute walk to Av. São João 677. Weather: Cold-front Sunday — 16 °C, 68 % rain, persistent grey day. Bring a layer and an umbrella; the cold-front warning the Saturday guide flagged came true. Tomorrow Monday cool-dry reset (20 °C, 10 % rain). Ride-hailing: 99 and Uber operate normally with predictable Sunday-evening Mother’s Day surge between 13h–15h (lunch returns) and 22h–23h (Espaço Unimed and Av. Paulista show egress). Metro runs reduced Sunday hours but covers all three principal venues directly. Safety: Standard Sunday — Centro and Barra Funda are quieter on Sundays than weekdays, the bairros are well-policed near the venues but the side-streets between Marechal Deodoro and Espaço Unimed thin after midnight; ride-hailing rather than walking on the return. São Paulo tonight runs at the cold-front Sunday gear — most outdoor circuits dampened, the indoor venues at full Mother’s Day capacity.

08

Neighbourhood Picks

By zone

Barra Funda Espaço Unimed · Menotti & Fabiano · Big Room The day’s biggest indoor Mother’s Day show. 8,000-cap, sertanejo dupla, two-decade catalogue, R$140 meia/R$280 inteira. Most reachable by 99/Uber from any city corner. Av. Paulista / Consolação Blue Note SP · Brunch + Evening · Free Entry Day Two-tier Av. Paulista day. Free Brunch Music 10h–17h with R$116 buffet, then Mother’s Day evening show 19h. The most polished single-venue plan, weather-proof, direct metro. Centro / República Bar Brahma · Damas do Samba · Indoor Day The indoor Mother’s Day samba lunch. Luana Gaudy 13h30, plus Forró no Centro, plus the Varanda lunch — the multi-stage day. Av. São João 677, Metro República, cold-front-proof. Augusta / Vila Madalena Cold-Front Dampened · Lower Sunday Capacity Standing nightlife circuits dampened. Augusta bars open but cold-front foot traffic; Vila Madalena terraces wet. D-Edge closed Sunday as standard. Tonight is not the night for the open-air bairros.

09

Frequently Asked Questions

The day operates as the country’s principal family-restaurant lunch day and the year’s most-booked Sunday for the high-end gastronomy circuit. World.title: Rio de Janeiro Nightlife Guide for Sunday, May 10, 2026
World.content:
The Rio Times · RT Nightlife Desk DIA DAS MÃES · QUARTETO INDIARA at Theatro Municipal Assyrio 11h · PEDRA DO SAL Sunday roda from 18h · BLUE NOTE RIO Sunday from 13h Copacabana brunch · CARIOCA DA GEMA dark Sunday · RIO SCENARIUM dark Sunday · 26 °C · 20 % rain · Mon May 11 · 21 °C · 35 % rain · Pedra do Sal Monday canonical roda 19h–midnight

01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

Sunday Rio de Janeiro nightlife runs on a slower, more domestic gear today: Sunday May 10 is Mother’s Day in Brazil (Dia das Mães, the second Sunday of May), and the city’s Sunday programme is built around family lunches in the afternoon and a small but specific set of evening anchors. The morning starts with the Música no Assyrio programme at the Theatro Municipal: the Quarteto Indiara — Marluce Ferreira (violino), Fernando Vilela (violão), Thiago Tavares (clarineta) and Lylian Moniz (violoncelo), all musicians of the OSB, OSTM and Petrobras Sinfônica — performs an eclectic Mother’s Day morning concert at 11h, tickets R$25. Across the day, the Pedra do Sal Sunday roda gathers from 18h on the Saúde cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana — third of the four active Friday-to-Monday nights, free, outdoor, the smaller-crowd alternative to Monday’s canonical roda. Blue Note Rio Copacabana opens its Sunday format at 13h with brunch and Sunday afternoon programming on the eighth floor, the windows open over the praia. The Lapa samba spine — Carioca da Gema, Rio Scenarium, Beco do Rato — is dark Sunday, as it is every week. Hot dry Sunday — 26 °C, 20 % rain, the cold-front warning that hung over Saturday softened overnight; tomorrow Monday cools to 21 °C with 35 % rain. Tomorrow’s headline: the canonical Pedra do Sal Monday roda from 19h to midnight on its 20th-anniversary year, plus Samba do Trabalhador with Moacyr Luz at Renascença Clube in Andaraí — the carioca week’s two most-loaded weekday samba programmes, both back tomorrow. Tonight: lunch with the family, an evening cobblestone roda, an early close.

02

Top Picks Tonight

Fast scan

Quarteto Indiara — Música no Assyrio at Theatro Municipal

11h · R$25 · Mother’s Day morning · Centro The Mother’s Day morning concert. Quarteto Indiara — violino, violão, clarineta, violoncelo — at the Assyrio salão of the Theatro Municipal. Eclectic repertoire across genres. Praça Floriano s/nº — Centro, entrada pelo Boulevard da Av. Treze de Maio. Metro Cinelândia.

Pedra do Sal — Sunday Roda

From 18h · Free · Saúde cobblestones The Saúde Sunday roda. Third of the four active Fri–Mon nights — easier to navigate than Monday’s canonical roda, more intimate than Friday or Saturday. Free, outdoor, on the cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana. R. Tia Ciata — Saúde.

Blue Note Rio — Sunday Brunch + Afternoon

From 13h · Copacabana · Av. Atlântica 1910 The praia-side Mother’s Day option. Casa opens 13h with brunch and live Sunday programming on the eighth floor, windows over Copacabana. The Av. Atlântica 1910 sit-down format with kitchen and bar, the long Sunday lunch.

03

Full Rundown

Theatro Municipal — Quarteto Indiara at Assyrio Centro · Mother’s Day · Chamber Music · R$25 The morning’s Mother’s Day anchor and the day’s most distinctive cultural booking. The Música no Assyrio programme at the Theatro Municipal do Rio de Janeiro presents the Quarteto Indiara — an unconventional chamber formation pairing Marluce Ferreira (violino), Fernando Vilela (violão), Thiago Tavares (clarineta) and Lylian Moniz (violoncelo). All four perform in the city’s principal symphonic ensembles — the OSB, the OSTM (Theatro Municipal’s own orchestra) and the Petrobras Sinfônica — and use the Indiara project to step out of those formal contexts and into a room-sized, accessible Sunday-morning format. The instrumentation is the point: violino, violão, clarineta and violoncelo is not a standard quartet, and the unusual combination lets the group move between classical, popular Brazilian and crossover repertoire without strain. The Assyrio sits underneath the Theatro Municipal proper, accessed via the Boulevard side on Av. Treze de Maio. Doors open ahead of the 11h concert; tickets R$25. Ideal Mother’s Day plan: morning concert, lunch in Centro or Lapa afterwards (Confeitaria Colombo on R. Gonçalves Dias is the historical Sunday-lunch carioca answer for this neighbourhood, just blocks away). Metro Cinelândia directly underneath. Sun May 10 · 11h · R$25 · Praça Floriano s/nº — Centro · entrada pelo Boulevard Av. Treze de Maio · Metro Cinelândia

Pedra do Sal — Sunday Roda Saúde · Free · Outdoor · Cobblestones · Fri–Mon The Sunday roda at the historical Pequena África site. Pedra do Sal runs Friday through Monday, free, outdoor, on the cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana in the Saúde neighbourhood. Sunday is the third of the four active nights — slightly busier than Friday and Saturday because Monday’s canonical roda draws so heavily from the same pool, but still well below the Monday peak. Tonight’s roda gathers from 18h and runs through the evening on the bar terraces around the largo. The site is recognised as Território Remanescente de Quilombo Urbano by the Fundação Cultural Palmares (2005) and as carioca cultural patrimony — the place where Tia Ciata, João da Baiana, Donga and Pixinguinha gathered in the early 20th century to develop the genre that defines the city. Bars and barracas around the largo handle food and drink (cash works best, low prices, caipirinha and cerveja). Mother’s Day plan: lunch in Zona Sul or Centro, evening Pedra do Sal. Sturdy shoes for the cobblestones. Phone in front pocket. The return is by taxi from the Largo, not on foot through Centro after dark on Sunday. Sun May 10 · From 18h · Free · Largo João da Baiana / R. Tia Ciata — Saúde · Metro Uruguaiana then walk · taxi return

Blue Note Rio — Sunday Brunch + Afternoon Programme Copacabana · Praia view · Sit-down · Sun from 13h The praia-side Mother’s Day option, and the day’s main sit-down family booking on the Av. Atlântica strip. The Blue Note Rio casa opens at 13h on Sundays with the standard Sunday format: brunch service, the kitchen running through the afternoon, live music programming on the salão de shows stage with the windows behind the band open over Copacabana. The eighth-floor room at Av. Atlântica 1910 sits across from Copacabana Palace, with the praia view through the panoramic windows. Mother’s Day in Copacabana means the venue runs near or at booking capacity from early afternoon — reservations strongly recommended for tables, particularly for the Praia-side window seats. The casa runs piano bar and gastronomia continuously through the afternoon; bar and snack service runs without ticket on the calçadão level. The route from Centro after the Theatro Municipal Quarteto Indiara morning is direct: Metro Line 1 from Cinelândia to Cantagalo or Siqueira Campos, ten minutes total. The casa is the most polished Mother’s Day option for those who want the praia framing without the chaos of a full Copacabana megaevent. Sun May 10 · From 13h · Av. Atlântica 1910 — Copacabana · Metro Cantagalo or Siqueira Campos · reservations recommended for tables

04

Suggested Route

● Plan A — Mother’s Day full day. Quarteto Indiara at Theatro Municipal Assyrio 11h, lunch at Confeitaria Colombo or another Centro Sunday spot, walk along the Centro corridor or take the metro to Copacabana, Blue Note Rio Sunday afternoon from 13h–17h. Late afternoon home for a rest. ● Plan B — The Pedra do Sal evening. Family lunch wherever you are, then transit to Saúde for the Sunday roda from 18h. Free, outdoor, the historical Pequena África site. Two hours on the cobblestones, taxi back by 21h. The most carioca Mother’s Day evening. ● Plan C — Praia-and-quiet Sunday. Morning praia in Copacabana, Ipanema or Leblon (26 °C, light cloud, 20 % rain), lunch at one of the kiosks or in Leblon, Blue Note Rio Sunday afternoon for the music programming. The lowest-friction Mother’s Day plan. ● The combined route: Theatro Municipal 11h, Centro lunch, Pedra do Sal 18h. The day from morning chamber music through evening cobblestone roda — the most layered carioca Mother’s Day plan, at minimal cost.

05

Still Going After 10 pm

Sunday after 22h: Pedra do Sal Sunday roda continues past midnight on the cobblestones, the bar terraces around Largo João da Baiana running until the music breaks. Blue Note Rio Sunday afternoon programme typically wraps by 19h–20h; the casa stays open for piano bar and gastronomia until late, but the structured shows are done. Carioca da Gema dark Sunday. Rio Scenarium dark Sunday. Beco do Rato dark Sunday. Circo Voador dark Sunday after the Friday-Saturday Nação Zumbi double. Cordão da Bola Preta dark Sunday after the Saturday Black Pantera launch show. The Lapa avenidas — Mem de Sá, dos Arcos, do Lavradio, da Relação — are the city’s quietest Sunday, less than 20 % of Saturday traffic, the kitchens at Nova Capela and a handful of other casas running until late but the structured shows all dark. Tomorrow Mon May 11: the Pedra do Sal Monday canonical roda from 19h to midnight at Largo João da Baiana — the city’s defining weekly samba gathering, in its 20th year, draws thousands. Samba do Trabalhador with Moacyr Luz at Renascença Clube in Andaraí also Monday — the parallel Monday institution. Both back tomorrow, both worth a working week’s anticipation.

06

Plan B

› Confeitaria Colombo — R. Gonçalves Dias 32, Centro. The 1894 belle-époque tea-room and Sunday lunch institution. The carioca Mother’s Day Sunday-lunch default; reservations or arrival before 12h essential. › Aprazível — R. Aprazível 62, Santa Teresa. The hilltop terrace with the Centro skyline view, Sunday lunch service, the Mother’s Day reservation booked weeks ago for the principal hours; check for late availability. › Bar Urca — R. Cândido Gaffrée 205, Urca. The sea-wall chope, the calmest Zona Sul Sunday afternoon. The simplest open-air Mother’s Day route. › Pink Flamingo Domingueira — late Sunday LGBTQIA+ programme from 21h, check the casa’s social channels for tonight’s location and lineup. The Sunday-night exception when most rooms are dark. › In São Paulo tonight: Mother’s Day Sunday in SP runs cold and wet (16 °C, 60 % rain) with the family lunch at full booking and the Blue Note SP Brunch Music 10h–17h free. The full RT São Paulo Nightlife Guide carries the SP detail. › Tomorrow Mon May 11: Pedra do Sal Monday canonical roda 19h–midnight (20-year-old gathering) · Samba do Trabalhador with Moacyr Luz at Renascença Clube · the carioca week’s most-loaded weekday samba.

07

Getting Around

Theatro Municipal (Centro): Metro Cinelândia (Line 1/2) directly underneath. Pedra do Sal (Saúde): Metro Uruguaiana then 10–15 minute walk through Centro to Largo João da Baiana — for the return, take a taxi from the Largo, do not walk back through Centro after dark on Sunday. Blue Note Rio (Copacabana): Metro Cantagalo or Siqueira Campos. Weather: Hot Sunday — 26 °C, 20 % rain, partly cloudy. Light layer for the evening; the Saturday cold-front warning eased overnight. Tomorrow Monday cools to 21 °C with 35 % rain. Ride-hailing: 99 and Uber operate normally. Sunday surge is generally lower than Saturday across the city, but Mother’s Day mid-afternoon (12h–15h) drives a one-day spike around restaurant clusters in Botafogo, Leblon, Centro and Copacabana — book ahead if your reservation is at a known Mother’s Day venue. Metro runs reduced Sunday hours but covers all the day’s principal sites. Safety: Standard Sunday — the Lapa avenidas are the city’s quietest of the week, the structured-show casas all dark; Saúde and Centro thin after dark; phone in front pocket as always. Rio de Janeiro tonight runs at the slowest Sunday gear — the city moves family-meal pace.

08

Neighbourhood Picks

By zone

Centro Theatro Municipal · Quarteto Indiara · Mother’s Day morning The morning anchor. Música no Assyrio 11h, R$25. Confeitaria Colombo two blocks away for the Sunday lunch. Direct metro at Cinelândia, the city’s cleanest Sunday-morning route. Saúde / Pequena África Pedra do Sal · Sunday Roda · Free The evening’s only structured outdoor samba option. Roda from 18h at Largo João da Baiana, free, on the cobblestones. Smaller crowd than Monday, the easier night to navigate. Taxi return. Copacabana Blue Note Rio · Sunday Brunch · Praia view The praia-side family Sunday. Casa opens 13h, brunch and live music with the windows over Av. Atlântica. Reservations strongly recommended for Mother’s Day. Av. Atlântica 1910. Lapa Dark Sunday · Carioca da Gema · Scenarium · Beco The Lapa samba spine is dark Sunday as it is every week — Carioca da Gema, Rio Scenarium, Beco do Rato all closed. Nova Capela kitchen until late for the cabrito. Returns full Wed onward; tomorrow Mon dark too.

09

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Sunday May 10, 2026 Mother’s Day in Brazil? Yes. Mother’s Day in Brazil falls on the second Sunday of May, and in 2026 that date is Sunday May 10. The day operates as the country’s principal family-restaurant lunch day; major venues across Rio de Janeiro are pre-booked weeks in advance for the 12h–15h window, particularly in Botafogo, Leblon, Centro and Copacabana. The Theatro Municipal runs a Mother’s Day morning concert at 11h, and Blue Note Rio in Copacabana opens its Sunday format from 13h. What is the Quarteto Indiara show at the Theatro Municipal? It is the Mother’s Day Sunday morning edition of the Música no Assyrio programme at the Theatro Municipal do Rio de Janeiro, on Sunday May 10, 2026 at 11h. The Quarteto Indiara features Marluce Ferreira (violino), Fernando Vilela (violão), Thiago Tavares (clarineta) and Lylian Moniz (violoncelo) — all musicians of the OSB, OSTM or Petrobras Sinfônica. The unconventional formation moves between classical and Brazilian popular repertoire. Tickets R$25. Address Praça Floriano s/nº, Centro, with entrance on the Boulevard side at Av. Treze de Maio. Is Pedra do Sal busy on Sunday? Sunday is the third of the four active Pedra do Sal nights — the roda runs Friday through Monday, free, outdoor, on the cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana from 18h. Sunday is busier than Friday and Saturday but well below the Monday peak; Monday’s canonical roda runs 19h to midnight in its 20th year and draws thousands. Sunday is the more navigable option for first-time visitors. Standard precautions: phones in front pockets, taxi return from the Largo rather than walking back through Centro. Are Carioca da Gema and Rio Scenarium open on Sundays? No. Both Carioca da Gema and Rio Scenarium are dark Sunday as part of their standing weekly programmation. Carioca da Gema operates Monday-Saturday with adjusted hours (Saturday peak 21h–04h; Friday 18h–04h with happy hour); Rio Scenarium operates Wednesday-Saturday only. The Lapa samba spine is consistently dark Sunday and Tuesday. Beco do Rato is also dark Sunday. The standing exception is Pedra do Sal in Saúde, which runs Friday through Monday including Sunday from 18h. What’s happening in Rio de Janeiro nightlife on Monday May 11, 2026? Monday is one of the carioca week’s most-loaded samba nights despite being a weekday. The canonical Pedra do Sal roda runs Mondays from 19h to midnight at Largo João da Baiana in Saúde — free, outdoor, in its 20th year, draws thousands. Samba do Trabalhador with Moacyr Luz at the Renascença Clube in Andaraí runs the same evening as the parallel institutional Monday programme. Carioca da Gema, Rio Scenarium and Beco do Rato remain dark Monday; the rest of the Lapa structured-show circuit returns Wednesday onward.

01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

Saturday São Paulo nightlife runs at full Mother’s-Day-weekend capacity with one of the rarer alt-rock bills of the year and a deep MPB bench behind it. Cine Joia hosts the night’s most distinctive convergence: Vapors of Morphine + Dean Wareham in a double full-set bill — Dana Colley’s continuation of the late Mark Sandman’s Boston catalogue (Morphine, 1989–1999) paired with Wareham‘s Galaxie 500 set built around the three-album 1988–90 dreampop trinity. Across the city in Várzea de Baixo, Daniel Boaventura takes Tokio Marine Hall for a Mother’s-Day-weekend MPB show — the polished sit-down option for the family circuit. On Av. Paulista, Blue Note SP runs both halves of its Saturday: Feijoada com Samba on the Varanda Blue 12h–16h with R$69 buffet + R$15 couvert artístico (free entry to the varanda), then the late evening show — Red Flame, the tribute band, plays Simply Red at 22h30 with Mother’s-Day promo at R$98 via Eventim. Around the three principal stages, the city’s standing Saturday peaks: Augusta corridor (Beco 203, Cabaret, Z Carniceria) at full capacity, Vila Madalena bars on Aspicuelta and Wisard, D-Edge in Barra Funda. Cool dry Saturday — 28 °C, 10 % rain. Critical: Sunday is Mother’s Day in Brazil, and a cold front arrives with the holiday — Sunday drops to 16 °C with 60 % rain. Tonight is the last warm Saturday before the autumn cold pattern sets in. Plan the family lunch in advance, plan the route home before midnight.

02

Top Picks Tonight

Fast scan

Vapors of Morphine + Dean Wareham at Cine Joia

Doors 20h · Pista R$210–420 · Fastix · Liberdade Two seminal US alt-rock legacies on the same stage. Dana Colley keeps the Morphine catalogue alive; Wareham revisits Galaxie 500’s Today/On Fire/This Is Our Music. Praça Carlos Gomes 82, Liberdade. Production by Maraty.

Daniel Boaventura at Tokio Marine Hall

Sat May 9 · Ticketmaster · Várzea de Baixo Mother’s-Day-weekend big-room MPB / pop. Boaventura’s catalogue spans three decades from the musical theatre stage to standards. The seated, family-bookable option for the night. R. Bragança Paulista 1281 — Várzea de Baixo.

Red Flame — Tributo a Simply Red at Blue Note SP

22h30 · R$98 Mães promo · Eventim · Av. Paulista Saturday-night Conjunto Nacional supper-club show. The Brazilian tribute band runs the Hucknall catalogue — “Stars”, “Holding Back the Years”, “Money’s Too Tight”. Mother’s Day Eventim cupom MAESEVENTIM brings inteira to R$98. Av. Paulista 2073.

Blue Note SP — Feijoada com Samba on Varanda Blue

12h–16h · R$69 buffet + R$15 couvert · Free entry Saturday samba feijoada on the Varanda — outdoor, view of Av. Paulista. Buffet à vontade R$69 (vegan option), couvert artístico R$15, free venue access. Live samba group rotates weekly. Pre-Mother’s-Day daytime Av. Paulista anchor.

Augusta Corridor — Beco 203 + Cabaret + Z Carniceria

From 22h · Indie + alt · Consolação The four-block Saturday standard. Beco 203 indie + rock to 04h. Cabaret alt-pop. Z Carniceria the latest at 05h. Last warm Saturday before Sunday’s cold front — pavement crowds out in force. R. Augusta + R. Frei Caneca.

03

Full Rundown

Cine Joia — Vapors of Morphine + Dean Wareham (full sets) Liberdade · US Alt-Rock Double Bill · Fastix The night’s most distinctive bill, and one of the rarer convergences of US alternative rock the city has hosted in 2026. Vapors of Morphine is the project that Dana Colley (baritone sax) built to keep alive the catalogue of the late Mark Sandman‘s Morphine — the Boston trio that ran from 1989 until Sandman’s death on stage in Italy in July 1999. The band’s signature: no guitar, two-string slide bass, baritone sax, drums; Albums Good (1992), Cure for Pain (1993), Yes (1995), Like Swimming (1997), the posthumous The Night (2000). The catalogue influenced everyone from Radiohead to Queens of the Stone Age. Colley plays alongside Jeremy Lyons (vocals/two-string bass) and Tom Arey (drums) tonight. Dean Wareham follows with a set dedicated to Galaxie 500 — the Massachusetts trio he founded in 1987 that produced just three albums (Today 1988, On Fire 1989, This Is Our Music 1990) before splitting, but whose dreampop / slowcore vocabulary went on to define a quarter-century of American indie — Slowdive, Yo La Tengo, Beach House, The National all carry the lineage. Both perform full sets. Production by Maraty. Doors at 20h. Tickets via Fastix: pista R$210 meia / R$420 inteira (3º lote); camarote R$220–440. Address Praça Carlos Gomes 82, Liberdade. Metro São Joaquim. Sat May 9 · Doors 20h · Pista R$210 meia / R$420 inteira · Praça Carlos Gomes 82 — Liberdade · Metro São Joaquim · Fastix

Tokio Marine Hall — Daniel Boaventura Várzea de Baixo · MPB / Pop · Mother’s Day Weekend · Ticketmaster The big-room family option for Mother’s Day weekend. Daniel Boaventura takes the Tokio Marine Hall on R. Bragança Paulista 1281 in Várzea de Baixo — the 4,500-capacity room that opened as Citibank Hall and now operates under the Tokio Marine naming-rights deal. Boaventura’s catalogue runs from the musical theatre stage (Os Miseráveis, O Fantasma da Ópera, the 1990s São Paulo-Rio circuit) through three decades of Brazilian pop and his more recent standards-and-bossa work; the live show typically alternates the originals with Sinatra, Tony Bennett and Brazilian classics, scored for a full band. The Saturday-before-Mother’s-Day timing positions tonight as one of the city’s most-booked family shows of the weekend — expect the room near capacity, the parking strip on R. Bragança Paulista at full Saturday surge from 19h. Tickets via Ticketmaster Brasil. The venue runs strict 19+ for the room without parental accompaniment; family booking the standard format. Easiest route: 99 / Uber from Zona Sul; metro Vila das Belezas (Yellow Line 4) is the closest station, then a short ride to the venue. Sat May 9 · R. Bragança Paulista 1281 — Várzea de Baixo · Metro Vila das Belezas + ride · Ticketmaster · check ticketmaster.com.br for show time

Blue Note SP — Feijoada com Samba + Red Flame (Simply Red Tribute) Av. Paulista · Day + Night · Eventim Two-tier Saturday on Av. Paulista. Paulista view, free venue entry, R$69 buffet à vontade with vegan option, R$15 couvert artístico for the live samba group (rotates weekly). Night: Red Flame, the established Brazilian tribute act, plays Simply Red at 22h30 in the salão de shows. Repertoire: “Stars”, “Holding Back the Years”, “Money’s Too Tight (To Mention)”, “Fairground”, “If You Don’t Know Me By Now” — the Mick Hucknall catalogue from Picture Book (1985) through the 2000s. Mother’s Day Eventim promo cupom MAESEVENTIM brings inteira to R$98 for the late session. Address Av. Paulista 2073, 2º andar — Conjunto Nacional. Metro Consolação directly underneath. 01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

Saturday Rio de Janeiro nightlife runs at full Lapa peak with two heavyweight political-rock anchors and a deep bench of samba behind them. Ao Vivo no Circo Voador” (Deck) to Cordão da Bola Preta — the Uberaba crossover-thrash trio, the first all-Afro-Brazilian band of its kind nationally, runs 19h to 01h with Imundos, Punhal and Gadelha Superdrive opening. Carioca da Gema at the Mem de Sá Saturday peak 21h–04h. Beco do Rato Friday-night-style roda runs Saturday. Pedra do Sal Saturday roda on the Saúde cobblestones from 18h, free, the second-easiest of the four Friday-Monday roda nights. Blue Note Rio Copacabana: free Feijoada Raiz with Amigos da Cacilda fanfarra 14h–17h, then the 22h30 ticketed evening show. Hot dry Saturday — 31 °C, 10 % rain. 02

Fast scan

Nação Zumbi — “Afrociberdelia 30 Anos” night 2 at Circo Voador

Feijoada 12h–18h · Night 20h–03h · Sympla Day: feijoada à vontade 13h–16h with Nando do Cavaco/Adilson da Vila live. Night: full three-floor Saturday programme to 03h. R$70 antecipado includes feijoada buffet. R. do Lavradio 20 — Lapa.

Carioca da Gema — Saturday Lapa Peak

21h–04h · Mem de Sá · Lapa The casarão at full Saturday capacity. Mesas das 21h30, salão livre after — back-bar position the strategic spot. The Mem de Sá institution since 2000, runs to 04h. Av. Mem de Sá 79 — Lapa. Fever for mesas.

Pedra do Sal — Saturday Roda

From 18h · Free · Saúde cobblestones The historical samba option. Saturday roda at Largo João da Baiana — second of the four Fri–Mon active nights, smaller crowd than Monday’s canonical roda. Free, outdoor, on the cobblestones. R. Tia Ciata — Saúde.

03

Full Rundown

Circo Voador — Nação Zumbi “Afrociberdelia 30 Anos” night 2 Lapa · Manguebeat · Anniversary · Sold Out · Opener BNegão The second of two consecutive sold-out nights at the lona. Nação Zumbi celebrates 30 years of “Afrociberdelia” — the 1996 second album produced by paulistano Eduardo Bidlovski (BID) and the last studio record led by Chico Science before his death in February 1997 at 30. The album took manguebeat — the Recife-born movement that fused maracatu drums with rock, hip-hop, dub and electronics — to its commercial and aesthetic peak. The remaining lineup — Jorge Du Peixe (vocals), Lúcio Maia (guitar), Pupillo (drums), Toca Ogan, Gira and Gilmar Bola 8 — has carried the catalogue forward for three decades. Tonight’s set revisits “Manguetown”, “Maracatu Atômico”, “Etnia”, “Quando a Maré Encher” and the title track. Saturday opener: BNegão — the carioca rapper-vocalist (ex-Planet Hemp’s Cabeça de Nego, leader of BNegão e Os Seletores de Frequência), a contemporary fellow-traveller of the manguebeat circle. Pista runs DJ Lencinho. Doors at 20h. Sold out — esgotado em ambos os dias per the casa de shows. The lona is at R. dos Arcos s/n in Lapa, capacity 2,200, and the post-show release directly into the Lapa avenida system feeds the rest of the night’s circuit. Sat May 9 · Doors 20h · SOLD OUT · R. dos Arcos s/n — Lapa · Metro Cinelândia

Cordão da Bola Preta — Black Pantera “Resistência!” launch Lapa · Crossover Thrash · Articket · 18+ The heavy show of the night, three blocks from Circo Voador. Black Pantera — the Uberaba (Minas Gerais) trio formed in 2014, the first all-Afro-Brazilian crossover-thrash band of national reach — celebrates the launch of “Resistência! Ao Vivo no Circo Voador”, their first audiovisual, released yesterday (Friday May 8) on Deck. The record was captured at a previous Circo Voador show; tonight’s celebration moves up R. dos Arcos to the Cordão da Bola Preta casarão on R. da Relação 03 — the same building that hosts the legendary Carnaval bloco of the same name (founded 1918, now ~2 million followers each Carnaval Saturday). Lineup: Charles Gama (guitar/vocals), Chaene da Gama (bass), Rodrigo “Pancho” Augusto (drums). Catalogue politically explicit — racism, discrimination, the songs “Fogo nos Racistas” and “Cola” most recent singles. The promised format: sem grade, stage dive liberado, roda punk. Carioca openers Imundos, Punhal, Gadelha Superdrive. Show runs from 19h to 01h Sunday. Tickets R$70 + R$7 taxa (2º lote antecipado) via Articket. Production by Tomarock. 18+. Sat May 9 · 19h–01h · R$70 + R$7 · R. da Relação 03 — Lapa · Metro Carioca · Articket

Rio Scenarium — Feijoada Raiz + Saturday Night Programme Lapa · Three Floors · Feijoada · Sympla · Sat 12h–03h The casarão’s full Saturday — split between the day feijoada and the night programme. Day: house opens at 12h, the buffet de feijoada à vontade is served 13h–16h in the Pavilhão da Cultura with the carnes nobres (costela, lombo, carne seca, paio), arroz branco, farofa, couve, linguicinha acebolada, aipim frito, laranja — plus the vegan tofu-and-vegetable option. Live music with Nando do Cavaco or Adilson da Vila on rotation, three one-hour sets between 13h and 17h. The day closes at 18h. Night: re-opens at 20h with the full three-floor Saturday format — Palco Scenarium for the headline shows, Salão Anexo for samba/gafieira/chorinho, Palco Dolores for the late DJ. Runs to 03h Sunday. Tickets R$70 antecipado for the day include the feijoada buffet; night tickets separate. Three floors at full Saturday capacity, the casarão voted by The Guardian among the world’s 10 best bars, R. do Lavradio 20. Sat May 9 · Feijoada 12h–18h · Buffet 13h–16h · Night 20h–03h · R. do Lavradio 20 — Lapa · Sympla

Blue Note Rio — Feijoada Raiz + Saturday show Copacabana · Free Feijoada · Eventim · 22h30 The Copacabana option, two-tier Saturday. Feijoada Raiz runs 14h–17h on the calçadão / piano bar level — free entry, no reservation, with the regular Blue Note buffet feijoada and the resident Saturday band Amigos da Cacilda, the Favela Brass-trained fanfarra crew that has become a fixture of carioca carnival street parade circuit. House opens at 11h. The 22h30 evening show in the salão de shows requires a ticket; the Eventim listing for tonight currently flags “ingressos voando”, so book ahead — programmation announced day-of via the casa’s social channels. The room runs the standard Blue Note format: tables, gastronomia, attentive listening. Address Av. Atlântica 1910, eighth floor, with the Copacabana praia view through the windows behind the stage. Metro Cantagalo or Siqueira Campos, plus extensive piano bar / calçadão programme before and between shows for those who want the venue without the ticketed set. Sat May 9 · Feijoada Raiz 14h–17h free · Evening show 22h30 · Av. Atlântica 1910 — Copacabana · Metro Cantagalo · Eventim

Lapa Samba Floor — Carioca da Gema + Beco do Rato Lapa · Saturday Samba · Late Close The Saturday Lapa samba spine. Carioca da Gema opens at 21h Saturday — different from the Friday 18h door — and runs the headline show through to 04h Sunday. Mesas guaranteed until 21h30; after that the salão runs livre with no seating guarantee but the room never empties before close. The Happy Hour summer-2026 promotions (caipirinha dose dupla, R$12.99 cervejas, 50% porções) carry through Saturday in the bar areas. Av. Mem de Sá 79; Fever for mesas, walk-in for the salão. Beco do Rato on R. Joaquim Silva 11 runs its Saturday roda from 18h through 02h — the smaller, more local Lapa option, good fallback when Carioca da Gema and Rio Scenarium peak too loud. Both venues sit within three blocks of Circo Voador and Cordão da Bola Preta, so the post-show pivot from either heavy show into the late samba room is two minutes on foot. Carioca da Gema · Sat 21h–04h · Av. Mem de Sá 79 · Fever · Beco do Rato · Sat 18h–02h · R. Joaquim Silva 11 — Lapa

Pedra do Sal — Saturday Roda Saúde · Free · Outdoor · Cobblestones The Saúde Saturday roda. Pedra do Sal runs Friday through Monday, free, outdoor, on the cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana in the Pequena África district. Saturday is the second-easiest of the four active nights (Monday’s canonical roda is the busiest; Friday-Saturday-Sunday are smaller and more navigable). Tonight’s roda gathers from 18h, builds through the evening and runs past midnight on the bar terraces around the largo. Bars and barracas handle food and drink (cash works best, low prices, caipirinha and cerveja). The site itself is recognised as Território Remanescente de Quilombo Urbano by the Fundação Cultural Palmares (2005) and as carioca cultural patrimony — the place where Tia Ciata, Donga and Pixinguinha gathered in the early 20th century to develop the genre. Sturdy shoes for the cobblestones. Phone in front pocket. The return is by taxi from the Largo, not on foot through Centro after midnight. Sat May 9 · From 18h · Free · Largo João da Baiana / R. Tia Ciata — Saúde · Metro Uruguaiana then walk · taxi return

04

Suggested Route

● Plan A — Manguebeat night (if you have a ticket). Both Circo Voador nights are sold out; only proceed if you secured one in advance. Light dinner in Lapa around 19h, doors 20h, BNegão opens, Nação Zumbi takes the stage around 22h. Late close direct into the Lapa avenida system, with Carioca da Gema or Rio Scenarium two minutes away. ● Plan B — Heavy night. Black Pantera at Cordão da Bola Preta — show 19h start, the casarão runs to 01h. R$70 antecipado via Articket. Sem grade, stage dive, roda punk. After the show, walk to Lapa rooms for the late close. ● Plan C — Lapa samba Saturday. Stay in Lapa entirely. Rio Scenarium feijoada from 13h with Nando do Cavaco, then home for a nap, then back at 21h for Carioca da Gema. The lowest-friction Saturday with the most flexibility. ● Plan D — Pedra do Sal + Lapa. Metro Uruguaiana, walk through Centro to Saúde for the roda from 18h. Stay until 21h, taxi back to Lapa for Carioca da Gema or Beco do Rato until close. The most carioca Saturday route. ● Plan E — Copacabana. Free Feijoada Raiz at Blue Note Rio 14h–17h, beach in the afternoon, evening show at 22h30. The praia-side Saturday, the calmest of the five plans.

05

Still Going After 10 pm

Saturday after 22h: Nação Zumbi in mid-set at Circo Voador. Black Pantera deep into the Cordão da Bola Preta show with the openers warmed up. Rio Scenarium peaking between 22h and 02h, three floors busy. Carioca da Gema Saturday peak from 22h onward, runs to 04h. Beco do Rato Saturday roda runs to 02h. Blue Note Rio 22h30 evening show in full flight. Pedra do Sal Saturday roda continues past midnight on the cobblestones. Nova Capela on Av. Mem de Sá 96 keeps the kitchen open late for the Lapa cabrito assado — the natural close after the rooms shut. Sun May 10: 26 °C, 35 % rain, the day’s main programme is recovery brunches across Zona Sul plus the Pedra do Sal Sunday roda from 18h; Carioca da Gema dark Sunday, Rio Scenarium dark Sunday. Mon May 11: cold front arrives — 21 °C with 65 % rain, the canonical Pedra do Sal Monday roda 19h–midnight goes ahead regardless plus Samba do Trabalhador with Moacyr Luz at Renascença Clube in Andaraí. Tonight is the last warm Lapa-pavement night of this stretch.

06

Plan B

› Comuna — R. Sorocaba 585, Botafogo. Saturday craft-beer + indie crowd. The Botafogo bypass to Lapa. › Jobi — R. Ataulfo de Paiva 1166, Leblon. Late-Saturday pavement crowd. The Leblon institution since 1956. › Bar Urca — R. Cândido Gaffrée 205, Urca. The sea-wall chope, the calmest Zona Sul Saturday. The pre-cold-front warm-night pavement-sit option. › Bip Bip — R. Almirante Gonçalves 50, Copacabana. The 60-year-old samba living-room, cooler-on-the-floor, the smallest official-unofficial samba spot in the city. › In São Paulo tonight: Saturday programmes across Augusta, Vila Madalena, Blue Note SP feijoada from 12h. The full RT São Paulo Nightlife Guide carries the SP detail. › Tomorrow Sun May 10: Pedra do Sal Sunday roda from 18h · Blue Note Rio Sunday brunch · Carioca da Gema dark · Rio Scenarium dark · 35 % rain risk afternoon · recovery brunches Zona Sul.

07

Getting Around

Lapa cluster (Circo Voador, Cordão da Bola Preta, Carioca da Gema, Rio Scenarium, Beco do Rato): Metro Cinelândia or Carioca — both walking distance to all five rooms. Cordão da Bola Preta on R. da Relação 03 is closer to Carioca; Circo Voador on R. dos Arcos closer to Cinelândia. Blue Note Rio (Copacabana): Metro Cantagalo or Siqueira Campos. Pedra do Sal (Saúde): Metro Uruguaiana then 10–15 minute walk through Centro to Largo João da Baiana — for the return, take a taxi from the Largo, do not walk back through Centro after midnight. Weather: Hot dry Saturday — 31 °C, 10 % rain. Light clothing; hydrate at the rooms. Sunday turns: 26 °C, 35 % rain. Monday cold front: 21 °C, 65 % rain — Saturday is the last warm-night option for outdoor Lapa pavement-sitting and Pedra do Sal cobblestone roda. Ride-hailing: 99 and Uber operate normally with predictable Saturday surge after midnight in Lapa and Copacabana — wait five minutes after the show ends and prices ease. Safety: Standard Lapa Saturday — no event lockdowns, no Av. Atlântica closures. The main avenues — Mem de Sá, dos Arcos, do Lavradio, da Relação — are busy and well-lit until 04h. Phone in front pocket; no visible jewellery; the cross-streets between the avenidas thin out after midnight. Rio de Janeiro tonight runs at full ordinary Saturday capacity — the city moves normally.

08

Neighbourhood Picks

By zone

Lapa Nação Zumbi · Black Pantera · Carioca da Gema · Scenarium The night’s gravitational centre. Nação Zumbi night 2 at Circo Voador (sold out), Black Pantera launch at Cordão da Bola Preta, then the Lavradio + Mem de Sá samba rooms at full Saturday capacity until 04h. Saúde / Pequena África Pedra do Sal · Saturday Roda · Free The historical samba option. Roda from 18h at Largo João da Baiana, free, outdoor, on the cobblestones. The carioca alternative for those who want the genre at its origin without a ticket. Copacabana Blue Note Rio · Free Feijoada · 22h30 show The praia option. Feijoada Raiz with Amigos da Cacilda 14h–17h free; ticketed evening show 22h30. The bairro at normal Saturday capacity, no event lockdown, the Av. Atlântica window view operating at full visibility. Botafogo / Urca Comuna · Bar Urca · Quietest Zone The Zona Sul Saturday calm. Comuna for craft beer and indie regulars. Bar Urca for the sea-wall chope. The bairros that bypass Lapa entirely; pre-cold-front warm pavement-sit option.

09

Frequently Asked Questions

Are tickets still available for Nação Zumbi at Circo Voador on May 9, 2026? No. Both nights of the Nação Zumbi “Afrociberdelia 30 Anos” run at Circo Voador — Friday May 8 and Saturday May 9, 2026 — are sold out. The Saturday show features BNegão opening with DJ Lencinho on pista; doors 20h. The 1996 album celebrates 30 years and is the last studio record led by Chico Science before his death in February 1997. Resale platforms apply at buyer’s risk; the casa has not announced extra dates. What is the Black Pantera show at Cordão da Bola Preta? It is the Rio launch show for “Resistência! Ao Vivo no Circo Voador”, the band’s first audiovisual, released Friday May 8, 2026 on Deck. The crossover-thrash trio from Uberaba — Charles Gama, Chaene da Gama and Rodrigo “Pancho” Augusto — plays Cordão da Bola Preta at R. da Relação 03 on Saturday May 9 from 19h to 01h. Carioca openers Imundos, Punhal and Gadelha Superdrive support. Tickets R$70 + R$7 fee via Articket. Sem grade, stage dive liberado, roda punk. 18+. When is the Rio Scenarium Saturday feijoada? Rio Scenarium opens at 12h on Saturday May 9, 2026, with the full feijoada buffet served à vontade from 13h to 16h in the Pavilhão da Cultura. Live music with Nando do Cavaco or Adilson da Vila on rotation, three one-hour sets from 13h to 17h. The day session closes at 18h; the night programme reopens at 20h and runs to 03h Sunday across three floors. Tickets antecipados from R$70 include the buffet. Address R. do Lavradio 20 in Lapa. Is Pedra do Sal busier on Saturday or Monday? Monday is significantly busier. The canonical Pedra do Sal roda runs Mondays from 19h to midnight and has done so for over 20 years; it draws thousands and is recognised as the city’s defining weekly samba gathering. Saturday’s roda from 18h is one of the four Friday-to-Monday active nights and is smaller, with an easier crowd to navigate. Both are free, outdoor and on the cobblestones at Largo João da Baiana in Saúde. How do I get from Cordão da Bola Preta to Carioca da Gema after the Black Pantera show? It is a five-minute walk. Cordão da Bola Preta sits at R. da Relação 03 in the Lapa-Centro border; Carioca da Gema is at Av. Mem de Sá 79, three short blocks south on the main Lapa avenida. The route is well-lit and busy with Saturday crowd until 04h. No metro or taxi needed. The same applies for the walk between Cordão da Bola Preta and Circo Voador (R. dos Arcos), Rio Scenarium (R. do Lavradio 20) and Beco do Rato (R. Joaquim Silva 11) — all within a six-block radius.

World.title: Argentina Unveils Super RIGI With 15% Tax to Land $30B Investors
World.content:
Argentine President Javier Milei and Economy Minister Luis Caputo unveiled on May 8 a “Super RIGI” investment regime that cuts the corporate income tax for qualifying mega-projects from 25% to 15%, allows companies to deduct 60% of investment in the first year, and eliminates export tariffs and import duties from day one.

Caputo said the new regime targets single-project investments of $20-30 billion in copper, lithium batteries, electric vehicles, solar panels, fertilizers, AI data centers, nuclear energy, LNG and uranium, with the original RIGI pipeline already at $94.965 billion approved plus $67.755 billion under evaluation.

Caputo also confirmed Chevron will present a separate $10 billion Vaca Muerta project under RIGI, taking cumulative submissions above $100 billion or roughly one-sixth of GDP, while the Super RIGI bill goes to Congress next week with provincial Ingresos Brutos capped at 0.5% and zero municipal sales taxes for adhering jurisdictions.

Key Points

— Income tax cut to 15% (vs 25% under existing RIGI) for qualifying mega-projects. — Accelerated amortization: 60% year 1, 20% year 2, 20% year 3. — Zero import tariffs on all production-related goods, zero export tariffs. — Provincial Ingresos Brutos capped at 0.5%, no municipal sales taxes. — Existing RIGI pipeline at $94.965B approved + $67.755B under review; Chevron adds $10B.

From RIGI to Super RIGI

The Rio Times, the Latin American financial news outlet, reports that Caputo presented the Super RIGI on May 8 as the second-generation upgrade of the original Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones (RIGI) approved under the Bases law in 2024. Caputo described single-project investments in the $20-30 billion range as the targeted scale, citing examples that include lithium battery factories, electric-vehicle plants, solar-panel and wind-turbine production lines, copper-refining and rolling mills, and AI data centers. The headline change is the corporate income tax rate cut from the RIGI’s 25% to 15% for qualifying projects, paired with an aggressive accelerated-depreciation schedule that lets investors deduct 60% of capex in year one, 20% in year two, and 20% in year three.

The original RIGI pipeline currently stands at $94.965 billion in approved or applied projects, with another $67.755 billion under evaluation, according to Caputo. The most recent RIGI sanction was Transportadora Gas del Sur’s $700 million expansion of the Perito Moreno gas pipeline. With Chevron’s separately announced $10 billion Vaca Muerta project added in coming weeks, total cumulative submissions are expected to exceed $100 billion, equivalent to roughly one-sixth of Argentine GDP.

What Sectors Qualify

Caputo identified strategic sectors covering the entire copper value chain (mining, refining, rolling), lithium-battery production, electric-vehicle factories, solar panels and wind turbines, fertilizers, nuclear energy, uranium, LNG, AI and data centers. The framing connects to recent regional discussions where Argentina joined a US-led critical-minerals strategic alliance to develop Western supply chains as China currently controls roughly 80% of global copper and lithium refining. Vista Energy’s CEO Miguel Galuccio said the company will register its Águila Mora and Bandurria Norte blocks under the new regime, citing the improved return on investment for Vaca Muerta drilling under the more favorable tax structure.

Tariff and Tax Architecture

The Super RIGI eliminates import tariffs on all production-linked goods, broadening the existing RIGI’s narrower scope which only covered capital goods, and enshrines a zero-export-tariff regime from day one replacing the original RIGI’s progressive schedule. Provincial Ingresos Brutos taxes are capped at 0.5% for adhering jurisdictions while municipalities are prohibited from sales-tax collection on covered projects. The minimum investment threshold per project has not yet been set in the bill text but is expected to be substantially above the existing RIGI’s $200 million floor, with Caputo arguing the package is calibrated against benchmarks already offered by competing global jurisdictions for similar mega-projects.

Provision RIGI (current) Super RIGI (May 8) Corporate income tax 25% 15% Year-1 amortization Standard schedule 60% (then 20% / 20%) Import tariffs Capital goods only All production goods, 0% Export tariffs Progressive schedule 0% from day 1 Provincial Ingresos Brutos Provincial discretion 0.5% cap (adhering) Municipal sales taxes Municipal discretion Prohibited (adhering) Pipeline approved $94.965B +$67.755B under review Trade-balance impact target $40B+ annual Per Caputo statement Chevron Vaca Muerta deal $10B (incoming) Separate filing Latest RIGI sanction TGS Perito Moreno $700M pipeline expansion

Connected Coverage

For more on Argentina’s macro environment, see Argentina’s country risk falling near 500 on the Fitch effect and our analysis of how Argentina’s industry and construction sectors rebounded in March 2026.

What Happens Next

Next week: Bill text submitted to Argentine Congress for legislative process.

Bill text submitted to Argentine Congress for legislative process. Coming weeks: Chevron $10 billion Vaca Muerta project formal RIGI filing.

Chevron $10 billion Vaca Muerta project formal RIGI filing. 2H 2026: Provincial adhesion votes for Ingresos Brutos cap and municipal opt-ins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Argentina’s Super RIGI?

The Super RIGI is the second-generation upgrade of Argentina’s investment-incentive regime, announced by Economy Minister Luis Caputo on May 8 and slated for submission to Congress next week. It cuts the corporate income tax for qualifying mega-projects from 25% to 15%, allows accelerated amortization of 60% in year 1, 20% in year 2 and 20% in year 3, and zeroes out export tariffs and import duties on all production-linked goods. Provincial Ingresos Brutos taxes are capped at 0.5% for adhering jurisdictions and municipalities are prohibited from charging sales taxes, with Caputo targeting single-project investments of $20-30 billion.

Which sectors qualify?

The Super RIGI is calibrated to attract investment in copper mining and the full refining-rolling value chain, lithium-battery production, electric-vehicle plants, solar panels, wind turbines, fertilizers, AI infrastructure and data centers, nuclear energy, uranium and LNG. The framing matches Argentina’s role in the US-led critical-minerals strategic alliance, given that China controls approximately 80% of global copper and lithium refining and the US is seeking Western alternatives. Caputo singled out copper as a priority, with Vista Energy already signaling intent to enroll Vaca Muerta blocks Águila Mora and Bandurria Norte under the new regime.

How big is the existing RIGI pipeline?

The original RIGI pipeline currently stands at $94.965 billion in approved or formally submitted projects, with an additional $67.755 billion under evaluation, and Chevron’s incoming separate $10 billion Vaca Muerta filing will push total cumulative submissions above $100 billion. The threshold is equivalent to roughly one-sixth of Argentine GDP, with the most recent RIGI sanction being Transportadora Gas del Sur’s $700 million Perito Moreno gas-pipeline expansion. Caputo said the combined RIGI and Super RIGI flows could improve Argentina’s structural trade balance by more than $40 billion annually once the projects ramp up to full operating capacity through 2027-2030.

What does Chevron’s $10B deal mean?

Chevron’s $10 billion Vaca Muerta project, confirmed by Caputo this week, is filed under the existing RIGI rather than the Super RIGI but signals US oil-major commitment to Argentine shale, pushing total cumulative RIGI filings above $100 billion or roughly one-sixth of Argentine GDP. The Chevron filing follows the trade-balance turnaround driven by Vaca Muerta exports and Vista Energy’s expansion, with Vista CEO Miguel Galuccio confirming Águila Mora and Bandurria Norte blocks under the new tax regime. The combined upstream pipeline targets long-term Argentine oil and gas exports above $30 billion annually by the early 2030s.

World.title: Latin American Pulse for Saturday, May 9, 2026
World.content:
Argentina Súper RIGI Announced — Caputo: 15% Corporate Tax, 60% Year-One Depreciation, Zero Export Tariffs, US$140B Pipeline + Chevron US$10B Vaca Muerta — Bill to Congress Monday May 11 — US-Iran Fire Exchange in Hormuz: CENTCOM Says Iran Attacked 3 Destroyers, US Strikes Qeshm + Bandar Abbas, Iran Says “Crossed Point of No Return,” Trump: “Just a Love Tap,” Brent $101.26 — Lula-Trump 30-Day Tariff Working Group Outcome: Beef-Fillet Lunch, US-Brazil Joint Financial-Asphyxiation Track, No Memorandum on Critical Minerals, No Cuba Invasion — Costa Rica: Fernández Sworn In as 50th President, Second Woman, Chaves Becomes Minister of Presidency + Finance — Bolivia: COB Declares Indefinite General Strike at 00:00 Friday, Túpac Katari + CSUTCB Demand “Immediate Resignation of Rodrigo Paz,” 18 Blockades in La Paz + Beni, Cochabamba Meeting Saturday — Peru: López Aliaga Refuses to Recognise Runoff Result, Calls “March of the Four Quarters” Today 17:00 — Neoenergia/Iberdrola R$47B Capex Largest in Brazilian History — Mexico CPI 4.45%/Core 4.26% Validates Banxico Cut — Brazil March Industrial Production +4.3% YoY — Colombia: Cepeda Pivots Constituent Assembly to “National Agreement”

Executive Summary The Big Picture: Friday closed three storylines that will define Latin American capital allocation for the remainder of 2026. In Buenos Aires, Economy Minister Luis Caputo unveiled the Súper RIGI in a press conference at the presidential palace alongside Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni and Security Minister Alejandra Monteoliva — a new investment regime that cuts the corporate income tax from 25% to 15%, frontloads depreciation at 60% in year one, eliminates export tariffs from day one, eliminates import tariffs on all production inputs, caps the provincial gross-receipts tax at 0.5%, and prohibits municipal sales taxes. The targeted sectors are copper refining and laminating, lithium batteries, electric vehicles, solar panels, wind turbines, potassium and phosphorus fertilisers, uranium, datacenters, and agro-forestry. Caputo said investment requests under the new regime “could approach US$140 billion in the coming weeks” and that “a single project could be US$20 to US$30 billion in scale.” Adorni confirmed a Chevron Vaca Muerta project of “another US$10 billion” would join the pipeline shortly. The Mercedes-Benz Zárate plant inaugurated the same day represents US$110 million and 2,500 jobs — the first new automotive plant built from scratch in Argentina in 15 years. The bill goes to Congress on Monday May 11. The Hormuz fire exchange repriced oil. Late Thursday into Friday, US Central Command said three US Navy guided-missile destroyers including the USS Mason were attacked by Iranian missiles, drones, and small boats while transiting the strait. The US conducted self-defence strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Port and Bandar Abbas. Iran’s Foreign Ministry called the US action a “clear violation of the April 8 ceasefire understanding.” Trump told ABC News the strikes were “just a love tap” and the ceasefire remains in effect, then posted on Truth Social: “We’ll knock them out a lot harder, and a lot more violently, in the future, if they don’t get their Deal signed, FAST!” Brent intraday fell to US$96.10 then bounced to a high of US$103.70, closing US$100.06 Thursday and rising 1.20% to US$101.26 Friday. Fitch raised its 2026 Brent forecast to US$87 from US$70 and lengthened the assumed Hormuz closure from one-to-two months to five months. Iran’s 48-hour response window expired Friday with no formal text received per Secretary Rubio. The Lula-Trump White House meeting outcome added a 30-day tariff working-group framework, with Brazil’s federal tax authority and US counterparts opening a joint financial-asphyxiation track against transnational organised crime; no critical-minerals memorandum of understanding was reached, and Trump told Lula directly there are “no plans” for a Cuba invasion. Two political transitions and one institutional crisis. Costa Rica’s Laura Fernández was sworn in as the 50th president and the second woman in history at the National Stadium, with delegations from 71 countries including King Felipe VI, Panama’s Mulino, and Ecuador’s Noboa. Outgoing President Chaves immediately took the simultaneous portfolios of Minister of the Presidency and Minister of Finance — an unprecedented arrangement that preserves his immunity through 2030. In Bolivia, the country’s main labour federation (the Central Obrera Boliviana, COB) declared an indefinite general strike at 00:00 Friday in coordination with the Túpac Katari peasant federation, the CSUTCB, and the La Paz neighbourhood-association federation, with the unifying demand being the resignation of President Rodrigo Paz. The state highway agency reported 15 to 18 blockades concentrated in La Paz and Beni; the truckers’ confederation lifted its measures after a separate agreement. Vie May 8: López Aliaga (Renovación Popular) en reunión prensa extranjera Lima — “La segunda vuelta no puede proclamar lo que es un delito contra la voluntad popular, vamos a ir hasta las últimas consecuencias; si es necesario movilizar al pueblo lo haremos”; no reconocerá ni Fujimori ni Sánchez si JNE no acepta exigencia revisar todo proceso; pedirá Tribunal Constitucional declare nulidad parcial/total + acudir organismos internacionales no precisados; convocará “marcha de los Cuatro Suyos” sábado May 9 (HOY) 17:00 — referencia a movilización Lima 26-28 julio 2000 contra tercera reelección Alberto Fujimori; ONPE 98.98% escrutinio: Fujimori 17.16% (2,843,215 votos), Sánchez 12.04% (1,994,505), López Aliaga 11.89% (1,972,943) — gap ~21,562 votos a Sánchez; pidió anular votación mesas serie 900 (zonas remotas Amazonía donde tiene voto residual); abogado Wilmer Medina aceptó “no todas las mesas favorecen a Sánchez”; JNE rechazó por unanimidad solicitudes elecciones complementarias (no contempladas en Ley Orgánica de Elecciones para procesos generales); Renovación Popular legisladores asumirán pero él no — “no puedo ser tan irresponsable de dejar al Perú sin senadores ni diputados”; Fujimori comenzó campaña segunda vuelta y rechazó “insurgencia”; Juntos por el Perú “rechazó maniobras desestabilizadoras y antidemocráticas” — pidió “JNE no alterar calendario electoral y culminar proceso de proclamación”; resultados definitivos esperados quincena mayo per JNE secretaria general Yessica Clavijo; JNE presidente Roberto Burneo bajo presión; ex jefe ONPE Piero Corvetto renunció post-elecciones; Fiscalía investigando irregularidades distribución material electoral; runoff confirmado 7 junio

What Happened

— Renovación Popular candidate Rafael López Aliaga announced Friday in a press conference with foreign correspondents accredited in Lima that he will not recognise the second-round result whether Keiko Fujimori or Roberto Sánchez wins, unless the National Election Board (JNE) reviews the entire process. “The second round cannot proclaim what is a crime against the popular will. We will go to the last consequences. If necessary, we will mobilise the people,” he said. He will ask the Constitutional Tribunal to declare the process partially or totally null and will appeal to international organisations not yet specified. He will convene a “March of the Four Quarters” — Marcha de los Cuatro Suyos — for Saturday May 9 at 17:00 in Lima, a deliberate reference to the July 26-28, 2000 mobilisation against Alberto Fujimori’s third re-election. With the election authority (ONPE) counting at 98.98%, Fujimori leads with 17.16% (2,843,215 votes), Sánchez has 12.04% (1,994,505), and López Aliaga is third with 11.89% (1,972,943) — about 21,562 votes behind. He requested the annulment of the “series 900” ballot stations (remote Amazonian areas where his vote is residual) — though his lawyer Wilmer Medina conceded “not all stations favour Sánchez.” The JNE rejected complementary-election requests by unanimous vote, noting the figure is not contemplated in the General Election Law. Renovación Popular’s elected senators and deputies will take their seats — “I cannot be so irresponsible as to leave Peru without senators or deputies,” López Aliaga said — but he himself will not. Fujimori began her second-round campaign Friday and rejected calls for “insurgency.” The runoff is confirmed for June 7. Background: Peru runoff: Fujimori-Sánchez at the F16 cap.

What Happened

— Neoenergia, the Brazilian utility controlled by Spain’s Iberdrola at 84% following the September 2025 PREVI buyout, announced Friday May 8 a R$47 billion (US$9.5 billion) five-year capital-expenditure commitment across four distributors triggered by 30-year concession contracts moving toward signature. Coelba in Bahia leads the package with R$25 billion (US$5.1 billion) through 2030. Cosern in Rio Grande do Norte is committed to R$4 billion (US$810 million). Neoenergia Pernambuco and Neoenergia Brasília account for the balance under the same renewal cycle. The cycle 2026-2030 capex runs 82% above the R$25.8 billion deployed in 2021-2025 and represents the largest distribution-grid investment cycle in Brazilian history. Neoenergia serves more than 16 million customers covering 40 million Brazilians. Pernambuco’s early renewal to 2060 set the Brazilian precedent for the cycle. The R$47 billion commitment locks Neoenergia into capital deployment that will be reflected in Brazil Regulatory Asset Base calculations, supporting tariff revenues across the 30-year concession horizon — though execution risk emerges if costs escalate beyond budget. Iberdrola’s posture follows the company’s strategic pivot from Mexico (US$4.2 billion exit on regulatory uncertainty) into Brazilian regulated utilities under 30-year concession renewals, stable regulations, and inflation-protected revenues. Q1 2026 net profit was R$1.2 billion (US$228 million), up 28% year-on-year. Coverage: Spain’s Iberdrola to invest $9.5 billion in Brazil grid renewal.

What Happened

— Mexico’s national statistics agency INEGI reported Friday May 8 that headline annual inflation eased to 4.45% in April from 4.59% in March, below the 4.50% consensus. Month-on-month inflation registered 0.20%. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, fell to 4.26% from 4.45% — the lowest reading in months, and the cleanest deceleration print of 2026. Categories that decelerated include food and non-alcoholic beverages 6.36% versus 6.91% prior, alcoholic beverages and tobacco 7.97% versus 8.05%, housing and utilities 3.08% versus 3.13%, health 5.25% versus 5.43%, restaurants and hotels 6.89% versus 7.16%, and miscellaneous goods and services 4.81% versus 5.52%. Transportation prices rose faster at 3.14% versus 2.62% — reflecting the higher fuel costs linked to the Hormuz energy shock. The print validates the Bank of Mexico decision Thursday to cut the policy rate by 25 basis points to 6.50% in a split vote and close the 14-cut, 450 basis-point easing cycle that began in March 2024 from an 11.25% peak. Banxico’s statement: “Looking ahead, the Governing Board estimates that it will be appropriate to maintain the reference rate at its current level.” President Claudia Sheinbaum said the cut “activates investment.” Banxico minutes are due May 21. What is Argentina’s Súper RIGI announced on May 8, 2026?

Economy Minister Luis Caputo announced the Súper RIGI on Friday May 8 in a Casa Rosada press conference alongside Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni and Security Minister Alejandra Monteoliva. The new investment incentive regime reduces the corporate income tax rate to 15% (from 25% under the current RIGI), allows accelerated amortisation at 60% in the first year and 20% in each of the second and third years, eliminates export tariffs from day one, eliminates import tariffs on all production inputs, caps provincial Ingresos Brutos at 0.5%, and prohibits municipal sales taxes.
